title: TXIO and serialized block bodies
source_identity: SOURCE-REVISION.txt and artifact-manifest.json identify the committed packaging source. Development-runtime checks below are scoped to their exact executable hash; final packages and hosted delivery require separate checks.

storage.new_raw_body_allocation: NTFS hard links share verified allocation across independent cache, retained and durable names; unsupported filesystems preserve durability with measured independent-copy fallback.

native_measured_blocks_0_and_1.scope: Canonical commit and body payload only; excludes receipts, private accelerators, heads, filesystem allocation and retained legacy copies.

source_browser_suites.scope: Controlled source fixtures including TXIO navigation, potential-range clipping, gesture boundaries, stale responses and unobscured reserved controls.

update_apply_suite.initial_failure: A parallel run exceeded the existing healthy-startup acknowledgement timeout. The isolated case and subsequent complete serial suite passed; the original timeout remains recorded.

development_native.published_0_7_3_profiles: Automatic versioned migration preserved original commitments, settings and the validated header snapshot.
development_native.real_bitcoin_relationship: Original output 0.0.9 and spending input i0.1.170 resolved in both directions through saved TXIO API and compiled UI without fallback.
development_native.cold_restart_and_eviction: Both saved links remained known after restart and disposable source-byte eviction. Unavailable block bytes returned an explicit error.
development_native.renderer: Genuine genesis map/flow, desktop and narrow compiled layouts, 120/180px constrained toolbars, keyboard zoom/Fit, fullscreen, content isolation, media and recursion passed.
development_native.limitations: Development executable predates the final enqueue guard and storage-allocation correction. Chromium DOM and screenshots do not establish native WebView sharpness.

windows_cleanup_identity.missing_windows_symlink_privilege: Only three link-specific subtests skip; other safety assertions execute.

hosted_delivery.render_auto_deploy: enabled, on commit to main; independently verified

notes: Unknown or unresolved TXIO results do not prove that an output is unspent.
Blocks provide ordered transaction knowledge independently of the Transaction Index.
Canonical facts, retained raw bytes and rebuildable private accelerators have separate lifetimes.
Fresh profiles check automatically but do not install automatically without opt-in; existing explicit preferences are preserved.
GitHub publication and Render code deployment alone do not prove signed client delivery.
Windows executables remain unsigned. Local antivirus diagnostics do not establish clearance on other machines.
No local profile, credential, private signing key or personal audit artifact is included in release inputs.
